"Training days, a kind reminder after closing"
We write to travelers

Travel notice for the Companion Animal Travel Desk

Travelers need to know that routine support for companion animals continues to follow careful safety checks and calm handling.

The senior coordinator oversees daily service decisions, and the team works with steady attention to each journey as a shared responsibility. Please keep pet papers, carrier details, and feeding notes ready so the desk can review them without delay. If a traveler is bringing Scout or another pet, clear and complete information helps the staff make safe arrangements.

After closing, the desk still records service updates and passes any urgent concerns to the right staff member. This keeps the next day organized and helps protect animal comfort, traveler plans, and smooth handover between teams. If travel plans change, let the desk know as early as possible so the support can stay aligned with the journey.

Please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help with any pet travel concern.
